summary: Master destination marketing and tourism promotion with a 5-day intermediate course. Learn segmentation, campaign design, KPI dashboards, and ROI-driven strateg
lede: Destination marketing training helps tourism promotion professionals turn audience and destination insights into practical campaigns. Participants develop traveler segments and positioning, plan campaigns across digital and distribution channels, and create dashboards to measure bookings and campaign performance. The course is for practitioners responsible for tourism promotion who need to build a marketing plan and communicate its results to stakeholders.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who lead destination marketing, tourism promotion, and regional development strategies. It is ideal for intermediate practitioners with prior experience in marketing or tourism, focusing on practical application of segmentation, positioning, and performance analytics. This course is designed for: Destination Marketing Organization (DMO) Manager:
audience: Tourism Ministry Official: Develop national promotion policies
Regional Marketing Director: Lead multi-channel campaigns
Destination Development Lead: Drive infrastructure and product
Tourism Product Manager: Design high-conversion offers
Digital Marketing Specialist: Manage social media, SEO
Crisis Communication Officer: Develop response plans
Sustainability Coordinator: Integrate ESG metrics and community
Data Analyst: Build KPI dashboards and perform
Influencer Marketing Coordinator: Partner with travel influencers
modules: Destination Marketing Foundations and DMO Strategy
Market Segmentation and Traveler Persona Development
Full-Funnel Marketing Planning and Channel Strategy
Digital Channel Management and Customer Journey
Conversion Optimization and Booking Journey Design
Sustainability and Policy Integration in Marketing
prerequisites: Participants should have prior experience in marketing or tourism, with a basic understanding of digital marketing concepts. Familiarity with marketing analytics tools is beneficial but not required. No coding or programming skills are needed to complete the course. Participants must bring a laptop for hands-on exercises; no pre-installed software is required as datasets and tools are provided.
